description: This file defines a utility class and related structures for parsing command-line flags, including flag matching rules, aliasing, and handling of different flag types. It provides an interface for creating, parsing, and managing command-line flags in a flexible manner, supporting features like help text, XML output, and compatibility with gflags.

classes.name: Flag
classes.description: Represents a command-line flag with methods for configuration, parsing, and output.

classes.name: FlagAlias
classes.description: Defines a matching rule for a flag, including mode and name.

classes.name: FlagMatch
classes.description: Represents a successful match of a flag argument, including key and value.

methods.name: Alias
methods.description: Adds an alias to trigger matches and call the setter.

methods.name: Help
methods.description: Sets help text for the flag.

methods.name: Getter
methods.description: Sets a loader function to display the current value in help text.

methods.name: Setter
methods.description: Sets the callback to invoke when the flag is matched.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses a list of arguments, removing matches and invoking setters.

methods.name: WriteGflagsCompatXml
methods.description: Outputs the flag in gflags XML format.
